environment.browser: Chromium headless DevTools Protocol (actual Viewer loaded with real PLY)
environment.limitation: Headless/background timer throttling makes rAF frame-gap and FPS incomparable to a visible GPU window; renderMs is CPU submission, not GPU completion.

before.backend: run_reconstruction is async + spawn_blocking; emits per-frame progress at 1 fps; geometry is PLY file via asset path, not JSON IPC. Artifact events contain only kind/path (under 200 bytes).

after.notes: Confidence moved to confidence.worker.ts (off main thread). Flood reuses cached grid/mask; slider updates in-place colour blend. Controls render on invalidate() only. Model reload disposes geometry/materials; heap flat across 3 reloads with forced GC.

unmeasured: three consecutive Tauri reconstruction heap snapshots
